name: Enable or disable a season baseline
description: Admin only: `{"enabled": true}` puts an admitted baseline in play and `false` takes it out, at any time before the close. There is no delete: a baseline's matches and ratings name its version. ENABLING moves it `disabled` -> `active`: from the next pair run it is paired, rated, on the ladder and seated opposite trials, and the first enable seeds its two ratings at the season's prior with their seq-0 events, so it starts in placement like any promoted version; enabling it again keeps the ratings it had. DISABLING moves it back, which takes it off the ladder and out of pairing, and cancels in the same statement the matches seating it that nobody has claimed (BASELINE_DISABLED); a claimed or running one finishes and is counted. A cancelled trial is re-paired against the baselines still in play. Both bump the roster epoch and write a baseline_events row. A baseline still being admitted, or one admission refused, cannot be enabled. Asking for the state it is already in changes nothing and answers 200 with it.

with.name: Admins only
with.description: The role is read off the live session rather than off a claim in the cookie, so revoking a session or demoting a user takes effect on the next request.

body.detail: The body is {"enabled": true} or {"enabled": false}.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object('found', true, 'closed', se.closed_at IS NOT NULL, 'status', v.status, 'reject_reason', v.reject_reason) AS body FROM model_versions v JOIN models e   ON e.id = v.model_id JOIN users u    ON u.id = e.owner_id AND u.role = 'baseline' JOIN seasons se ON se.id = v.season_id JOIN games g    ON g.id = se.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND se.slug = ($2)::text AND lower(u.handle) = lower('baseline.' || ($3)::text) ORDER BY (v.status <> 'rejected') DESC, v.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.name: Flip it, and seed or cancel what that means

input.query: WITH target AS ( SELECT v.id, v.weight_class, se.rules FROM model_versions v JOIN models e   ON e.id = v.model_id JOIN users u    ON u.id = e.owner_id AND u.role = 'baseline' JOIN seasons se ON se.id = v.season_id JOIN games g    ON g.id = se.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND se.slug = ($2)::text AND lower(u.handle) = lower('baseline.' || ($3)::text) AND se.closed_at IS NULL AND v.status = CASE WHEN ($4)::boolean THEN 'disabled'::model_status ELSE 'active'::model_status END FOR UPDATE OF v ), flipped AS ( UPDATE model_versions v SET status = CASE WHEN ($4)::boolean THEN 'active'::model_status ELSE 'disabled'::model_status END FROM target WHERE v.id = target.id RETURNING v.id, v.weight_class, target.rules ), rated AS ( INSERT INTO ratings (version_id, ladder, mu, sigma) SELECT f.id, l.ladder, coalesce((f.rules -> 'rating' ->> 'prior_mu')::float8, ($6)::float8), coalesce((f.rules -> 'rating' ->> 'prior_sigma')::float8, ($7)::float8) FROM flipped f CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (f.weight_class), ('open'::ladder)) AS l (ladder) WHERE ($4)::boolean ON CONFLICT (version_id, ladder) DO NOTHING RETURNING version_id, ladder, mu, sigma ), seeded AS ( INSERT INTO rating_events (version_id, ladder, seq, mu_after, sigma_after) SELECT version_id, ladder, 0, mu, sigma FROM rated ON CONFLICT (version_id, ladder, seq) DO NOTHING RETURNING 1 ), cancelled AS ( UPDATE matches m SET status = 'cancelled', withdrawn_reason = 'BASELINE_DISABLED', closed_at = now() FROM flipped WHERE NOT ($4)::boolean AND m.status = 'pending' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM match_seats s WHERE s.match_id = m.id AND s.version_id = flipped.id) RETURNING m.id ), bump AS ( UPDATE clocks c SET epoch = c.epoch + 1, updated_at = now() FROM flipped WHERE c.key = 'roster' RETURNING c.epoch ) INSERT INTO baseline_events (version_id, action, by_user, cancelled) SELECT flipped.id, CASE WHEN ($4)::boolean THEN 'enable' ELSE 'disable' END, ($5)::uuid, (SELECT count(*) FROM cancelled) FROM flipped

SELECT season_baseline_json(v) AS body FROM model_versions v JOIN models e   ON e.id = v.model_id JOIN users u    ON u.id = e.owner_id AND u.role = 'baseline' JOIN seasons se ON se.id = v.season_id JOIN games g    ON g.id = se.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND se.slug = ($2)::text AND lower(u.handle) = lower('baseline.' || ($3)::text) ORDER BY (v.status <> 'rejected') DESC, v.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
